create.name: Upaya Zen Center
create.bio:
Upaya Zen Center is a Soto Zen practice community and residential temple in the foothills above Santa Fe, New Mexico. Roshi Joan Halifax, the Buddhist teacher and author known for her work on care for the dying, founded it and still leads it as abbot and head teacher, with a circle of guiding teachers who received their training there. Its teaching joins traditional Zen forms with what it calls socially engaged Buddhism: chaplaincy and end-of-life care, prison outreach and environmental work.

Daily life at Upaya follows a monastic rhythm of zazen, liturgy and work. Morning and evening meditation is streamed free on YouTube and Zoom, and a dharma talk by a resident or visiting teacher goes out live each Wednesday evening. Through the year the centre runs silent sesshin, month-long practice periods and study courses, most of which can be joined on campus or online, where the online places are offered for a donation. People can also live on site for three months or more in its residential Zen training, taking part in the schedule, study and work of the temple.

courses.title: ROHATSU: Circle of the Way (In Person 2026)
courses.description: An eight-day silent sesshin at the Santa Fe temple marking the Buddha's awakening, with sitting and walking meditation, formal meals, daily talks and private interviews. Roshi Joan Halifax leads it with Kazuaki Tanahashi and Upaya's senior teachers; places are by application.

courses.title: WINTER PRACTICE PERIOD: Moon in a Dewdrop (In Person 2027)
courses.description: A three-week residential practice period on campus built around Dogen's writings as translated by Kazuaki Tanahashi, with full days of zazen, seminars on Genjokoan, work practice and the monastic timetable.

courses.title: WINTER PRACTICE PERIOD: Moon in a Dewdrop (Online 2027)
courses.description: The online strand of the same three-week study and practice period on Dogen, followed from home at whatever pace suits each participant, with a shared resource page.

courses.title: Residential Zen Training
courses.description: Live at the temple for at least three months, following the daily schedule of zazen, liturgy and work, with study, seminars and guidance from Upaya's teachers.

free_resources.title: Daily Zazen online
free_resources.description: Morning and evening meditation from the Upaya zendo, open to anyone on Zoom or YouTube; sessions run silently with muted microphones and are offered for dana.

free_resources.title: ROHATSU: Circle of the Way (Online 2026)
free_resources.description: Online places for the December sesshin, joined from home through the livestreamed sittings and talks and offered for a donation.
